verdict.rationale: Undermind's MCP server lets AI agents (Cursor, Claude, VS Code) run it via natural-language 'open-ended research goals,' with the server planning searches, following citations, and synthesizing answers — a clear agentic natural-language interface layered over the core search product. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that MCP commands work reliably end-to-end, and explicit documentation that the core (non-MCP) product itself accepts free-form natural-language queries.
